source_method_summary: Experiment 6.1 determines the strength of a given sodium hydroxide solution using 0.1 M standard oxalic acid; the method refers standard-solution preparation to Experiment 2.1. Source calculation explicitly uses oxalic acid dihydrate molar mass 126 g mol−1. The material list specifies one 50 mL burette; one 10 mL pipette; one 100 mL conical flask; one burette stand; one funnel; one white glazed tile; one 100 mL measuring flask; oxalic acid, sodium hydroxide solution and phenolphthalein as needed. The source asks for three concordant readings. Its recorded titre/result table is blank; it supplies no NaOH unknown strength or measured titre.
